Based across Belo Horizonte and the project site in Brazil , you will work closely with project controls, commercial, procurement, finance and project delivery teams to monitor commitments, expenditure, forecasts, changes and cost performance. Track scope changes, variations, risks, opportunities and contingencies. Support progress claims, invoicing and project financial reporting. Review subcontractor and supplier progress claims, commitments and invoices. Assist with estimates, feasibility assessments and project financial planning. Work with project teams to improve cost awareness, data quality and forecasting accuracy. Provide timely cost information to project leadership, the client and relevant stakeholders. Informed by decades of experience, hundreds of projects, and global reach, driving industry benchmarks, our core focus is minerals processing. Our engineering-led approach tackles diverse challenges with confidence, incorporating modern technologies and innovative techniques across commodities. How To Express Your Interest In This Opportunity If you're eager to apply your skills and experience to our success and shape our future direction, then this role could be the perfect fit for you. Ability to establish effective working relationships across multiple disciplines and levels of the organization.

review_candidates.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
review_candidates.company: GATOR Lab @ UF - Geospatial Analytics, Technology and Open Research
review_candidates.description: !!! Please read https://gatorlab.io/join.html carefully !!! Postdoctoral Associate – Spatial Data Science & Discrete Global Grid Systems (DGGS) ​ About the Lab & University The Geospatial Analytics, Technology and Open Research (GATOR) Lab at the University of Florida conducts research at the intersection of GIScience, spatial data engineering, and open science. Part of UF’s School of Forest, Fisheries, and Geomatics Sciences, the lab is based at the Fort Lauderdale Research and Education Center in Davie, Florida (Miami–Fort Lauderdale metropolitan area). The University of Florida is a top-ranked public land-grant research university offering world-class computational resources (including the HiPerGator supercomputer) and a vibrant collaborative research environment. ​ Role Description We are seeking a Postdoctoral Associate (Postdoctoral Researcher / Fellow) in Spatial Data Science, Geoinformatics, Geomatics, or Computational Geometry to conduct advanced research on Discrete Global Grid Systems (DGGS) and scalable geospatial computing. ​Unlike traditional grant-bound roles tied to a single rigid deliverable, this position offers significant intellectual freedom to collaboratively shape the research agenda. Potential research directions include: DGGS Architecture & Benchmarking: Evaluating computational performance, geometric distortion, and cross-grid interoperability across hexagonal, pentagonal, triangular, and quadrilateral grids (e.g., H3, S2, A5, ISEA/DGGRID, HEALPix, rHEALPix). Spatial Scale & Aggregation Theory: Investigating modifiable areal unit and aperture effects, hierarchical indexing, and topological operations on the sphere/ellipsoid. Cloud-Native Geospatial & Earth Data Cubes: Integrating DGGS with modern spatial data infrastructures, vector/raster data cubes, and cloud-native formats (e.g., GeoParquet, DuckDB, Zarr, Xarray/xdggs). Open-Source Software & Standards: Developing open-source geospatial libraries, benchmarking suites, and contributing to OGC/ISO/ISPRS community initiatives. ​The Postdoctoral Associate will lead peer-reviewed publications, develop open-source research software, contribute to collaborative grant proposals, present at international conferences, and help mentor Ph.D. and M.S. students in the lab. This is a full-time, on-site position located in Davie, Florida (Miami–Fort Lauderdale Area). ​Qualifications ​Education: Ph.D. in Geomatics, GIScience, Geoinformatics, Geography, Computer Science, Computational Geometry, Earth System Science, or a closely related quantitative discipline by the start date. ​ Technical Skills: Strong scientific programming and software development skills in Python, R, C++, Rust, or modern spatial SQL (e.g., PostGIS, DuckDB). ​ Domain Experience : Demonstrated research experience in at least one of the following: ​Discrete Global Grid Systems (H3, S2, DGGRID, A5, HEALPix, etc.) or spherical/geodesic geometry. ​Spatial indexing, computational geometry, or polyhedral meshes. This isimportant! ​Large-scale spatial data engineering, cloud-native geospatial stacks, or Earth observation data cubes. ​Quantitative spatial analysis, spatial statistics, or GeoAI. ​Scholarship & Open Science: A strong track record of peer-reviewed publications, commitment to reproducible/open-source research (Git/GitHub), and excellent written and oral communication skills. ​ How to Apply For full position details, lab overview, and application instructions, please visit: https://gatorlab.io/join.html

review_candidates.title: Medical Assistant
review_candidates.description: Are you passionate about helping others and looking to grow your career in a supportive, mission-driven environment? Join one of Northern Nevada's Best Places to Work – Northern Nevada HOPES! PURPOSE: The Medical Assistant supports patients and healthcare providers in delivering a smooth, high-quality, and efficient care experience through clinical and administrative tasks. JOB SUMMARY: The Medical Assistant primary role is to deliver and assist healthcare providers in delivering high-quality, evidence-based care to patients while supporting the multidisciplinary team. The Medical Assistant actively engages with patients by providing education, resources, and hands-on support to promote optimal health and wellness. This role participates in both clinical and administrative tasks to deliver high-quality patient care. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Engage patients using a patientcentered approach by meeting them at their stage of readiness, building trust, and establishing strong rapport to support wellness goals. Room patients, complete intake assessments, collect vital signs, document relevant medical and other information in alignment with visit rooming requirements. Maintain professional boundaries with patients. Provide clinical and care coordination support by administering therapeutic medications, injections, immunizations, and performing diagnostic tests under the supervision of a provider. Maintain a safe care environment for patients and document care timely and accurately in the electronic medical record system. Support patient education, resource linkage, system navigation, and care followup, while identifying barriers to care. Assist with training or onboarding of medical assistants and medical assistant externs. Provide clinic and team support by communicating patient concerns to providers, participating in Medical Assistant team meetings, and helping ensure effective Medical Assistant practice. Contribute to clinic operations by notifying Medical Assistant leadership when medical supplies, therapeutic medications, or vaccines are running low and requesting replenishment. Uphold professional boundaries and demonstrate appropriate conduct within the Medical Assistant team and the multidisciplinary care team. Implement best practices in infection prevention and control by routinely cleaning and disinfecting high touch patient surfaces, exam rooms, and clinic areas in accordance with established HOPES policies and procedures. Ensure adherence to vaccine best practices by consistently applying the seven rights of vaccine administration, maintaining proper vaccine cold chain management, documenting administration of the vaccine in a timely manner, verifying provider vaccine orders for accuracy and compliance, and adhering to all HOPES policies and procedures surrounding vaccine administration. Promote excellent customer service by answering and returning patient phone calls in a timely manner and ensuring all administrative orders are processed in a timely manner. Maintain administrative workload expectations and proactively communicate with leadership when additional support or resources are needed. Provide Medical Assistant support to additional clinical services offered at HOPES, including but not limited to ultrasound, nutrition, prior authorizations, etc. Ensure accurate specimen collection, processing, and handling by verifying proper labeling with patient identifiers and confirming specimens meet specific laboratory requirements. Demonstrate effective communication and collaboration with direct leadership and multidisciplinary care teams. Collaborate with the clinical team to support continuous quality improvement by completing thorough chart preparation prior to patient visits and ensuring quality measures are met in alignment with visit rooming requirements. Prepare and set up procedures for providers by ensuring appropriate equipment, supplies, documentation, and patient readiness. Maintain CLIA compliance by adhering to established testing protocols, ensuring accurate specimen handling and documentation, performing quality control as required, and following all regulatory and organizational laboratory standards while upholding an uptodate CLIA office assistant laboratory license. Maintain secure and appropriate access to external medical record portals, including laboratory, hospital, and imaging systems, to support efficient information retrieval and care coordination. Promote teamwork and team building by supporting team members and demonstrating continuous efforts to uphold Medical Assistant professionalism and standards of practice. Demonstrate adaptability by incorporating process changes and maintaining compliance with updated policies, procedures, and workflows. Provide Medical Assistant float support as needed. At HOPES, we’re more than just a healthcare provider — we’re a team of changemakers dedicated to delivering affordable, high-quality medical, behavioral health, and support services to everyone in our community. Why Choose HOPES? PurposeDriven Work Be part of a team that’s transforming lives every day. Your work will directly contribute to improving health outcomes and building a stronger, healthier Northern Nevada. PeopleFirst Culture At HOPES, every team member is encouraged to bring their unique talents and perspectives to the table. Collaboration and innovation are at the heart of everything we do. Career Growth & Development We invest in your future by offering a mentorship program, leadership and soft-skills training, networking opportunities, and support for continuing education. Exceptional Benefits 100% employer-paid health insurance Life insurance options 3 weeks of PTO in your first year 12 paid holidays annually Paid Parental Leave (after 12 months) 24/7 Employee Assistance Program Click HERE to view a full list of benefits MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Completion of an accredited Medical Assisting program required. Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification required. Obtain CLIA Office Laboratory Assistant License within 30 days of hire required. Demonstrated proficiency with computer systems and software used in a clinical environment preferred. 2 years’ experience as a Medical Assistant preferred. Bilingual in Spanish and English preferred. Registered Medical Assistant (RMA)/Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) preferred. Due to real and potential conflicts of interest that exist when HOPES Behavioral Health providers render services to their coworkers, it is HOPES’ policy (Policy HR0005) that HOPES employees may not access HOPES Behavioral Health Services. For the same reason, current Behavioral Health patients/clients cannot be employed by HOPES. Accordingly, you hereby acknowledge and understand that if you are receiving services from a HOPES Behavioral Health provider at the time you are offered and accept employment with HOPES, you have the option of rescinding your acceptance of employment or finding a new behavioral health provider outside of HOPES before starting employment with HOPES.

review_candidates.description: Proč se přidat ke GasNetu? Staráme se o největší distribuční plynárenskou síť v České republice. Zajišťujeme bezpečné a spolehlivé dodávky plynu pro více než 2,3 miliónu odběratelů. Jsme součástí kritické infrastruktury a jsme nepostradatelní pro chod tuzemské ekonomiky. Máme silné zázemí v podobě odpovědných akcionářů, kterými jsou Skupina ČEZ, British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI) a Allianz Capital Partners (zastupující pojišťovací společnosti skupiny Allianz). Chci pracovat v GasNetu Vaší Pracovní Náplní Bude tvorba a aktualizace strategie Asset Class regulačních a předávacích stanic tlaku plynu, optimalizace nákladů a rizik na základě technického stavu aktiv, definice standardů a pravidel pro plánování investic s ohledem na budoucí trendy např. vodík, monitoring kvality a výkonu regulačních stanic, reporting KPI, koordinace interních týmů. Hledáme Právě Vás, Pokud máte VŠ/SŠ vzdělání technického směru - energetika, plynárenství, strojírenství, máte praxi v oblasti správy inženýrských sítí, liniových staveb či strojírenského zařízení - plynovody, vodovody, kanalizace apod., se orientujete v technické legislativě a normách, je pro vás výzva pracovat na strategických projektech s dopadem na energetickou budoucnost ČR, se chcete podílet na přípravě plynárenské sítě a zařízení na distribuci vodíku. Nabízíme Vám smlouvu na dobu určitou jako zástup za uvolněného zaměstnance pro výkon veřejných služeb - předpoklad 4 roky, pružnou pracovní dobu s možností práce z domova, prohlubování kvalifikace v oblasti plynárenství, semináře v oblasti zdraví, bezpečnosti a podpory životního prostředí, benefity, o kterých se dočtete níže. Jak to u nás chodí můžete vidět na videu na této stránce. review_candidates.title: Logistics Coordinator
review_candidates.company: ME Global Inc. dba ME Elecmetal
review_candidates.description: Description Position Purpose The Logistics Customer Service Coordinator is responsible for coordinating logistics operations while providing exceptional customer service throughout the order fulfillment process. This position manages inbound and outbound shipments, shipping documentation, warehouse coordination, order processing, delivery scheduling, and customer support to ensure products are delivered accurately, efficiently, and on time. Working closely with internal departments, international manufacturing facilities, logistics providers, warehouses, and customers, this role serves as a key liaison throughout the supply chain. The Logistics Customer Service Coordinator maintains accurate records, supports continuous process improvements, and ensures a high level of service for internal and external customers. Nature and Scope This position requires strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment. The Logistics Customer Service Coordinator must effectively prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy and responsiveness. The role works collaboratively with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Engineering, Finance, Customer Service, and external logistics partners across multiple regions. Excellent customer service, attention to detail, adaptability, and a sense of urgency are essential. Principal Responsibilities Coordinate customer orders from order entry through final delivery. Respond to customer inquiries and resolve logistics-related issues. Support international shipment coordination by tracking freight movement, customs clearance status, and final delivery arrangements. Monitor shipment status and proactively communicate updates, delays, and potential delivery impacts to customers and internal stakeholders. Schedule deliveries with customers, warehouses, and transportation providers. Maintain accurate shipping records and supporting documentation. Collaborate with Sales, Operations, Technical Services, Supply Chain, and Administrative teams to ensure customer requirements are met. Utilize ERP systems, such as SAP, Microsoft Office applications, and other business systems to manage orders, shipping information, inventory, and reporting. Identify opportunities to improve logistics processes and customer service efficiency. Support additional logistics and customer service initiatives as assigned. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Previous experience in logistics, customer service, supply chain, order management, or sales support. Familiarity with shipping documentation, such as commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading, and the roles of freight forwarders and customs brokers. Basic knowledge of Incoterms and how shipping terms affect transportation responsibilities, costs, and delivery coordination preferred. Experience working in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities and deadlines. Proficiency with ERP systems, preferably SAP, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office applications. Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail. Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to build effective working relationships with customers, vendors, and cross-functional teams in a multicultural environment. Demonstrated commitment to outstanding customer service and continuous improvement. Salary Description $65,000 - $85,000
